# NSW papers: what is released and why

<!-- Generated by tools/nsw-exam-releases.mjs from the release check. Do not edit by hand; run `node tools/nsw-exam-releases.mjs --write`. -->

Prithagoras offers HSC-style timed papers, each an "Answer-checked practice paper": sealed and marked by the server on final answers only, with no HSC mark, band, ATAR or prediction. A paper is **released** only when every one of its slots can be filled from at least 3 distinct approved question forms on the slot's outcome. An approved form is one (generator, difficulty) cell the Prithagoras edition issues (`server/platform/nswBanks.js`); one form yields many questions with different numbers but counts once.

The pool today: 267 approved forms. Blueprint structures (times, marks, section sizes) follow NESA's published HSC examination specifications for the 2024 syllabuses, first examined in 2027 (`docs/research/NSW_HSC_CURRICULUM_ASSESSMENT_AUTHORITY.md` §5.3). Which outcome each slot is on is Pri's own design: every Year 12 outcome of the examined course has slots. No NESA paper, question, marking guideline or reference sheet is reproduced. The platform has no authored formula sheet yet, so none is shown.
